chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abi Jamilah, from Abd Allah ibn Sulayman, from Abd Allah ibn Abi Ja'far, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, that he said:
Regarding the one-eyed eye that remains standing and is sunken, he said: "Ali عليه السلام ruled concerning it that there is half of the diyah of the sound eye."

key_terms.بِنِصْفِ الدِّيَةِ: with half of the prescribed blood-money compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for a damaged one-eyed or defective eye in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning injury to a defective or one-eyed eye. It states that Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام judged that such an eye carries half the compensation of a sound eye.
